key_patterns.pattern: Churned members with high open suspected gaps and low RAF recapture rate
key_patterns.meaning: Risk is walking out the door uncaptured — prioritize retention outreach and close suspected gaps before members disenroll to protect RAF integrity.

key_patterns.pattern: New members with large gap to potential risk and declining RAF recapture rate YoY
key_patterns.meaning: Newly attributed members are being under-documented at intake, suppressing prospective RAF; trigger early HCC gap closure workflows and ensure comprehensive welcome visits are completed.

key_patterns.pattern: Retained members with high documented risk but rising open dropped gaps and negative risk recapture rate YoY
key_patterns.meaning: Previously captured conditions are not being revalidated annually, creating RAF erosion on your most stable population; implement targeted recapture campaigns focused on chronic condition re-documentation.

key_patterns.pattern: Churned members with elevated eligible population and high open dropped gaps relative to documented risk
key_patterns.meaning: A large volume of members is leaving with unresolved dropped gaps, signaling systemic care continuity failures; coordinate with care managers to conduct gap closure prior to attribution loss and flag these members for transition-of-care intervention.
